blocks.description: Starts assembling a configuration. Stage 1 implementations are stub-normal, stub-timeout and stub-invalid.

blocks.text: add 3D service camera [CAMERA_ID] model [MODEL_JSON] placement [PLACEMENT_JSON] time [TIME_JSON]
blocks.description: Adds one camera: its camera model with distortion, the placement result it appears in, and its time correspondence.
Starts the service in a Worker and configures it. Waits for the answer or the configure timeout.
The configuration built so far: the cameras, their models and their placement. A recording carries this beside its pose frames.
Configures the service from a configuration in hand, such as the one a recording carries.

blocks.text: send pose frame [FRAME_JSON] from camera [CAMERA_ID] received [AGE_MS] ms ago
blocks.description: Forwards a camera's newest PoseFrame2D unchanged. Repeats, stale frames, invalid frames and frames of another calibration are not sent.

blocks.text: predict 3D pose to [LEAD_MS] ms after each request
blocks.description: Extrapolates each person's measured joints from the fused instant, a frame behind the newest camera frame, to the moment of the request plus LEAD_MS, for at most 200 ms, and marks them predicted. A negative LEAD_MS turns prediction off.
Asks for the current 3D pose and waits at most the request timeout.
Reports the validated twrmc/pose-frame-3d version 2 answering the latest request, or an empty string.
Reports the same frame as twrmc/pose-frame-3d version 1, with unmeasured joints at score 0.

blocks.text: update avatar poses for [SLOTS] slots releasing after [HOLD_MS] ms
blocks.description: Pairs the latest 3D frame with its 2D views under avatar slots slot-1 to slot-N. A person takes the lowest free slot and frees it after HOLD_MS unseen. Empty without a 3D frame.

blocks.text: avatar axes: up is reference [UP], audience is towards [AUDIENCE]
blocks.description: Names which reference axis points up and which towards the audience, each one of +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z. The avatar 3D pose is turned from the reference frame to those axes. The defaults, -y and -z, fit corners measured from the top-left, x right and y down.

blocks.text: avatar stage JSON for corners [CORNERS] camera at [DISTANCE_M] m
blocks.description: The projected pattern as a plane in the scene (centre, A-Frame rotation, width, height) and a camera DISTANCE_M in front of its centre facing it, from corners tlX,tlY;trX,trY;brX,brY;blX,blY in metres. Empty when they cannot be read.
Why the last avatar axes or stage could not be used, or empty.
PoseFrame3D v1 with person IDs replaced by avatar slots, or empty.
PoseFrame2D v1 whose tracking IDs are the avatar slots, or empty.
Which person holds which avatar slot, as a JSON array of {slotId, personId}.
Reports idle, configuring, ready, degraded or error.
Reports the latest error code and message, or an empty string.
Reports state, implementation, RTT, pose age, person count and frame counters as JSON.
Stops the Worker and clears the configuration and the 3D pose.
